summary: Full backend + mobile-web frontend regression for the synced Telecony Ops Tracker. Backend: 28/28 pytest cases PASSED covering auth for all 4 roles (Owner/PM/PCM/Engineer), dashboard shape, POs new schema (po_number/site_code/release_date/po_amount/status) + delete-by-po_number, Invoices create/toggle/delete, Costs with mandatory site_name validation, Owner-only cost deletion (Engineer & PM forbidden), Employees RBAC. Frontend (390x844): Owner sees all 4 tabs; PM sees po+operational only; Engineer sees only operational. Submit Ops: empty Site Name shows 'Site Name (nama kota) wajib diisi', cost with site_name creates successfully and appears in Transaction History with 'date • site_name' and submitter name; Owner sees tx-delete-<id> trash icons (13 shown), Engineer sees 0. Delete tx opens ConfirmModal with confirm-delete/confirm-cancel testIDs and DELETE /api/costs/{id} succeeds. PO & Invoice: '+ Add PO' modal with all 5 fields creates PO via POST /api/pos and appears in list showing PO number, Site Code, Release Date, PO Amount and status badge; NO 'Remaining PO' or 'Cost Utilization' anywhere. po-delete-<po_number> trash icon opens confirm modal and deletes via DELETE /api/pos/{po_number} verified via list re-fetch. Invoice add via invoice-add-button + inv-* fields creates via POST /api/invoices; status pill toggles Terbayar<->Belum; invoice-delete-<i> opens confirm modal and deletes via DELETE /api/invoices/{invoice_number}. Data persists in real MongoDB. No deprecated Expo/RN packages detected in package.json usage. No red screens. Two pre-existing minor RN warnings still present from previous iteration (see react_native_issues).

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated in RN; move to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:152

action_items: Optional: replace <View pointerEvents="none"> with style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }} in Toast (line 152).
Optional (from prior review): server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event startup/shutdown — migrate to lifespan context manager.
Optional: index.tsx is ~1377 lines; consider splitting Dashboard/POInvoice/SubmitOps/Employee into modules for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: PO POST accepts arbitrary project_name via optional field; backend defaults it to site_code when missing. This works but leaves 'project_name' in the returned PO — frontend doesn't display it (good). Consider removing project_name from the PO response schema or normalizing to site_code for clarity.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event; recommended lifespan context manager.

DELETE /api/pos/{po_number} and DELETE /api/invoices/{invoice_number} return 204 without checking existence — silent no-op on missing key. Consider 404 for observability, but current behavior is idempotent.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_/PO-TEST/INV-TEST/PO-UI/INV-UI prefixed data via API and self-clean where relevant (POs/invoices/costs deleted after verify). Some TEST_* costs/invoices/POs may remain but do not affect subsequent runs (unique IDs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: BASE_URL=$EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Test creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md: 00101 Owner, 00201 PM, 00204 PCM, 00202 Engineer, all pw=123. Confirm modal exposes testIDs confirm-delete / confirm-cancel. Owner-only trash icons: tx-delete-<cost_id>. PO delete: po-delete-<po_number>. Invoice delete: invoice-delete-<index>. Backend cost model no longer accepts remarks; site_name is mandatory (400 if empty/whitespace).
rca_of_issue: N/A — all requested features and flows verified working end-to-end.
